novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new measurement-and-mitigation route in the established subliminal-learning setting: the trait is a "trait-specific, decodable signature in the low-level distributional statistics" and can be suppressed by a "trait-agnostic, model-free" distribution-matching defense. Searches using "subliminal learning number distribution statistical signature", "hidden trait transmission divergence tokens", and "subliminal learning distribution matching defense" identify Cloud et al., “Subliminal Learning” (2025/2026), and “Towards Understanding Subliminal Learning: When and How Hidden Biases Transfer” (2025) as the closest work; the latter already attributes transmission to distributionally different rare tokens and suppresses it by masking them, while SynAlign (2025) provides an established data-resampling distribution-matching technique in another synthetic-data context. Moving from those works to aggregate feature decoding and model-free control matching is therefore a substantive, multi-step adaptation that changes the unit of analysis, but it is a natural extension and combination rather than a new core transmission mechanism or measurement paradigm.
